call_points.text: Management expects EBITDA percentage margin pressure in Q1 and Q2 due to elevated crude and raw material inflation.
Implemented price hikes in April: 5% in soaps, 6-7% in detergents, and 4-5% in household insecticides to counter inflation.
Godrej Fab portfolio reached an ARR of ₹500 Cr on gross sales (₹450 Cr net sales) and broke even in Q4.
Adopted ICAI EAC opinion netting customer-related spends against revenue, reducing both revenue and other expenses equally.
Expects Indonesia to deliver mid-single-digit volume growth and high single-digit value growth as pricing pressures abate.
Blended raw material inflation is tracking at 7% to 9% across the portfolio.
RNF molecule traction positions household insecticides to shift from low single digits to a high single-digit growth category.

operating_notes.text: Operating cash flow for FY26 stood at ₹2,488.46 crore.
Godrej Fab achieved an ARR of ₹500 Cr GSV (₹450 Cr NSV) in Q4 FY26 and reached breakeven.
Blended raw material cost inflation is tracking at 7% to 9% across the portfolio.
Price hikes taken in April 2026: 5% in soaps, 6-7% in detergents, and 4-5% in household insecticides.
Household insecticides penetration has risen from about 65% to 80%, with volumes growing at a 15% CAGR in recent years.
The first six categories make up close to 90% of GCPL's revenue.
Pet care white-space business has an ARR of around ₹10 Cr and is targeted at close to ₹50 Cr by end-FY27.

timeline.summary: Godrej Consumer Products Limited’s Board declared an interim dividend of ₹5 per equity share on May 6, 2026.

Godrej Consumer Products reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,900.44 Cr and PAT of ₹451.77 Cr, declared an interim dividend of ₹5 per share, and approved the re-appointment of Sudhir Sitapati as MD & CEO.
Godrej Consumer Products reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue growth of 11% YoY to ₹3,900 Cr with underlying volume growth of 6%.
Godrej Consumer Products Limited shared the audio recording of its May 6, 2026, investor and analyst conference call at 6:30 PM IST via its website.
Godrej Consumer Products Limited hosted its Investor Meet – 2026 presentation online on May 11, 2026, via its website.
GCPL hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, noting ₹500 Cr ARR in Fab, 4-7% April price hikes, and EAC-mandated trade spend netting.
On 23 October 2026, Godrej Consumer Products announced that its Indonesian subsidiary commenced commercial production at the new Kendal facility.
